research_question: Can a fixed market-information signal produce a stable SPY exposure process when portfolio state geometry changes across chronological samples?

shared_signal.name: balanced_regime_score_v1
shared_signal.description: Equal-weight development-only composite of slow trend, breadth, credit and volatility/rates modules inherited without tuning from Generation 4.

scientific_rationale: Generation 4 showed that different signal labels still converged to similar long/flat SPY return streams.
Generation 5 holds the information signal broadly constant and changes only exposure geometry, memory and transition rules.
Stateful rules reset at chronological validation discontinuities so no portfolio state leaks across purged folds.
The candidate count is reduced to twelve to limit multiple testing.
Selection considers chronological performance, PBO, return correlation, exposure correlation, state occupancy and transition stability.
Generation 3 and Generation 4 holdouts remain unavailable and are not used for design or tuning.
